harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The preposition phrase «من الدهر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حين»; the clause «لم يكن» is a naʿt of «حين», the linking element being implied (muqaddar), i.e.: in it (فيه).

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The preposition phrase «من نطفة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خَلَقْنا»; «أمشاج» is a naʿt (adjective), and a plural came as the attribute of a singular because it has a plural meaning; the clause «نبتليه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خَلَقْنا»; the clause «فجعلناه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نبتليه»; «بصيرا» is a multiple mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because the khabar (predicate) may be multiple, and likewise what was originally a khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «إما» is a particle of detailing; «شاكرا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «هديناه», i.e.: We guided him, both states having been made clear to him.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «كان» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كأس».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «عينا» is a badal (substitute) from {كَافُورًا}; the clause «يشرب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عينا»; and the clause «يُفَجِّرونها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يشرب».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «يوفون» is resumptive; «يوما» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «كان» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The preposition phrase «على حبه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الطعام», i.e.: being in their love of food.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The preposition phrase «لوجه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نطعم»; the clause «لا نريد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «نطعمكم»; the clause «إنما نطعمكم» is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied (muqaddar) saying which is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «يطعمون», i.e.: they give food, saying: we feed you only.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «يوما» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «قمطريرا» is a second attribute.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «فوقاهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نخاف»; «شرّ» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «نضرة» is the second mafʿūl bihi.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The preposition phrase «بما»: «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), i.e.: He rewarded them for their patience; «جنة» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «متكئين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «جزاهم»; the two preposition phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متكئين»; and the clause «لا يَرَوْن» is a second ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: His words «ودانية»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to {مُتَّكِئِينَ}; the preposition phrase «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «دانية»; «ودانية» includes the meaning of «مُشْرفة» (overlooking); «ظلالها» is the fāʿil (agent) of «دانية»; and the clause «ذُلِّلت قطوفها» is conjoined to the single word «دانية».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «ويطاف» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «جزاهم» in verse (12); the preposition phrase «بآنية» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition phrase «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يطاف»; the preposition phrase «من فضة» is attached to «آنية»; and the clause «كانت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أكواب».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «قوارير» is a badal (substitute) from the first; the preposition phrase «من فضة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قوارير»; and the clause «قدَّروها» is a naʿt of the second «قوارير».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause «كان» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كأسا».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «عينا» is a badal (substitute) from {زَنْجَبِيلا}; the preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عينا»; the clause «تسمى» is a naʿt of «عينا»; and «سلسبيلا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «ويطوف» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يسقون», and the conditional clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of «ولدان».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «ثَمَّ» is an adverb of place specific to the distant, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رأيت» before it; the object of the seeing is not mentioned.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: His words «عاليهم»: an accusative adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ثياب»; it is not made feminine because the mubtadaʾ is figuratively feminine; «خضر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ثياب»; the clause «وحُلُّوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the nominal clause «عاليهم ثياب»; «أساور» is a second object; the preposition phrase «من فضة» is attached to a naʿt of «أساور»; «شرابا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) «جزاء», and the second clause «كان» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «نحن» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun (نا) in «إنا».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «فاصبر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {نَزَّلْنَا}; the preposition phrase «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آثما».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «بكرة» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اذكر».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اسجد»; the fāʾ in «فاسجد» is redundant (zāʾida); the clause «اسجد» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause «اذكر»; «ليلا» is an adverb of time attached to «سبِّحه».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: «يوما» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), not an adverb.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «شددنا»; «تبديلا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause «إن هذه تذكرة»; the preposition phrase «إلى ربه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «اتخذ».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «وما تشاءون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «من شاء»; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يشاء» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «يُدخل» is resumptive; his words «والظالمين»: the object of an implied (muqaddar) verb, [assumed] as «عاقَبَ» (He punished); the clause of the implied verb is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يدخل», and the clause «أعدَّ» explains the implied verb.
